text:
A mains circuit can safely supply a current of 40A.
A hair-drier takes 2A. It is connected to the circuit by a lead which can carry up to 5A.
Which of these fuses would be best to use in the plug fitted to the hair-drier lead?
A
1A fuse
B
3A fuse
C
10A fuse
D
50A fuse
subject: Physics
